author: Fluid_Pie_9428
body:
Speaking from experience as a seasonal summoner

You're on the right track however I have a few issues with your set:

- Benefactor pumpkin is ass, sure the -1 turn is nice but it adds a possibility to use Arrowstorm I (which even with a bunch of buffs and high Att summons is complete doo-doo) that results in a waste of a turn, I'd suggest something like Fey Yeti Horns

- start ward turns for titans isn't necessary since you should start the fight off with a ward spell anyways and you always go first (unlike with normal fights where stuff like Immo lords or Succubi out speed you) so I'd say get a summon stat one

Regarding spells:

- Get rid of cockatrice summon, most of the time they'll just die before doing anything meaningful and the titans are immune to petrification anyways (Prometheus isn't for some reason tho)

- Leave only the VSS summon and maybe Buggane if you have him, with pledges it's kinda a battle against RNG if you want to utilise the Phoenix Ritual

Aside from that I think you're doing fine, maybe mix in some Rhada souls since Towerfall (which is probably what kills you the most frequently) does dark and holy damage which Rhada Souls will weaken as they have Holy/Dark resistance % (4% iirc which should be +-8% less damage from Towerfall for one rhad soul)
